title: Strongly measurable pasting of countably many relatively continuous operator fields
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, let (N_i)_{i∈ℕ} be measurable (Borel) subsets of E and let G_i: E → L(E, E) be continuous on N_i for each i. Then there is a strongly measurable g: E → L(E, E) such that g(y) = G_i(y) whenever i ∈ ℕ, y ∈ N_i and y ∉ N_j for all j < i.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (N : ℕ → Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (G : ℕ → Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ)), (∀ i, MeasurableSet (N i)) → (∀ i, ContinuousOn (G i) (N i)) → ∃ g : Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ), StronglyMeasurable g ∧ ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ N i, (∀ j < i, y ∉ N j) → g y = G i y
